body:
We ship from our Stock Warehouse in Phoenix, Arizona to customers across the United States, with some exceptions that are worth knowing before you order. This guide explains where free shipping applies, which areas are excluded, why we do not ship internationally, how state and local laws affect what we can deliver, how order review works and how to check whether we can ship to you. It follows our published [shipping policy](/shipping/) and is written for adults aged 21 and over. It is general information, and you are responsible for following the laws where you live.

## Where we ship
We deliver within the United States using regional carriers, with adult signature confirmation required on every parcel. Delivery times depend on your region: our published estimates are 3 to 7 business days in transit for the West Coast (Arizona, Nevada, Washington and Idaho) and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US. Places between those regions fall in between. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## Where free shipping applies
Free domestic shipping on orders of $200 or more after discount and before tax is valid for most of the 48 contiguous states. It does not apply to Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico, Hawaii, Alaska or APO, DPO, FPO and other U.S. military addresses. Orders to those places are subject to the standard shipping terms, and some may not be possible. If you live in one of those areas, contact us before you order and we will tell you what is available. See [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/).

## International shipping
We do not offer international shipping. Orders placed with international addresses will be cancelled and refunded. International customers can call us for help finding a local distributor. We do not ship to freight forwarders or reshippers who would send the parcel abroad, because that would also be international shipping. This is not a preference but a limit of what we can lawfully and practically do: vapor products are regulated differently in each country, and exporting them involves rules we do not handle.

## State and local law
Some states and cities restrict or ban certain vaping products, require licensing or tax stamps, limit flavors or restrict nicotine strengths. We cannot ship where the law does not allow it, and we may cancel orders that cannot be delivered lawfully. Because rules change and differ widely, it is your responsibility to check the rules for your area before you order. Read [state and local vape laws explained](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/) and [vape taxes by state](/blog/vape-taxes-by-state-overview/) for background, and the [PACT Act overview](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/) for the federal framework.

### What we may do if an order cannot be delivered lawfully
If we find that an order cannot lawfully be delivered to your address, we will contact you. In most cases we cancel the order and refund it through the payment method used, and we tell you why. We do this to protect you and us, because a parcel that cannot be delivered lawfully may be seized or returned.

## Order review
Orders may be reviewed to ensure security and accuracy. A review checks that the details are consistent and that the order can be delivered. If an order is under review, we contact you the same day. A review is routine and not a sign of a problem, and it may add a short delay to processing. See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/).

## Age and signature
Every delivery requires an adult aged 21 or older to sign, with government-issued photo ID. This applies in every state, to every parcel containing vapor products. The signature rule is part of federal law covered in our [PACT Act overview](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/), and it is explained in [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/). Choose an address where an adult can sign, and avoid P.O. boxes, because a carrier cannot obtain a signature at one. See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/).

## Before you order
Check your local rules and make sure your address is within our shipping area. If you are unsure whether we can ship to you, ask via the [contact page](/contact/) before you pay. Give us your state and the type of product you plan to order, and we will tell you what we can do. Review the [shipping policy](/shipping/) for the latest terms. If your address is in an excluded area, tell us so we can advise on your options.

## Common questions about addresses
### Can I ship to a workplace?
Often yes, if your employer allows personal deliveries and someone aged 21 or older will be available to sign. Check your workplace's rules first.

### Can I ship to a friend or relative?
Yes, within the United States, provided an adult aged 21 or older will sign with ID. Tell us in the order notes if the recipient's name differs from yours.

### Can I ship to a hotel?
It is possible, but risky, because hotel staff often cannot sign for adult-signature parcels. A private address is more reliable.

### Can I ship to a P.O. box?
No. A carrier cannot obtain a signature at a P.O. box, so use a street address.

### Can I ship to a military address?
APO, DPO and FPO addresses are excluded from free shipping, and delivery to them may not be possible. Contact us before you order.

## Why these limits exist
Our limits come from three sources: federal law, which requires adult signature and tax compliance; state and local law, which varies; and practical limits of regional carriers, which do not serve every area equally. Staying inside those limits protects customers from seized parcels and protects us from violations, and it is why we are clear about them up front.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Will you ship to my state?
Most states, yes, subject to local rules. If your state or city restricts a product, we cannot ship it. Ask us if you are unsure.

### Does shipping outside the 48 contiguous states cost more?
Free shipping does not apply there, and costs and availability vary. Contact us before you order.

### What happens if I order from outside the US?
The order will be cancelled and refunded. International customers can call us for help finding a local distributor.

## A worked example: checking whether we can ship to you
You live in a city that has recently introduced a flavor restriction. You are not sure whether the product you want is covered. You message us with your state, your city and the product page link. We check the rules we know of, tell you whether we can ship that product to your address and, if not, suggest products that are not affected. You decide what to order with the facts in front of you, and you avoid an order that has to be cancelled. This kind of question costs nothing and saves time, so ask whenever you are in doubt.

## Rules change, so check again
Laws on vapor products change often, and a product that could be shipped last year may be restricted this year. If you are a regular customer and your local rules change, tell us, and we will update how we handle your orders. If we learn of a change that affects your area, we will tell you before we ship. Keeping each other informed is the surest way to avoid a cancelled order.

## Frequently asked questions about restrictions
### Does the flavor of a product affect whether you can ship it?
In some places, yes. Certain states and cities restrict flavored products, so a flavor that is fine in one place may not be allowed in another. If you are not sure, ask before you order.

### Does nicotine strength affect shipping?
Some jurisdictions limit nicotine strengths or require specific labeling. If your area has such a rule, tell us and we will advise what we can ship.

### What if my area bans online sales of vapor products?
We cannot ship where the law prohibits it. If we learn that an order is going to such an area, we will cancel it and refund it through the payment method used.

### Do I have to prove where I live?
We confirm your age through the age gate and checkout, and the carrier confirms ID at delivery. We may contact you if something about an order needs clarification.

### What if I move?
Update your address on any new order, and tell us if you have a pending order that needs to change. Keep in mind that rules differ by place, so a move can change what we can ship to you.

## A note for travelers and people who move often
If you are traveling or between addresses, do not use a temporary location that you cannot be sure of, because a missed signature leads to a returned parcel. Order when you will be at an address for at least two to three weeks, or use an address where a trusted adult will be present. If you are moving soon, wait until you have settled, so that the parcel and the signature line up with your plans.
